title: Mosaic wall
description: A wall of five to eight pictures and clips fills the whole frame: one large tile and smaller ones on an uneven grid. The tiles open one after another, each from its own side (clip-path), and every picture keeps pushing in by 2 %. The title sits in a tile of its own, never on a picture. Any tile can be a video. Two columns on a phone.

props.items: required, 5-8 of {src, alt, poster, face} (or plain paths): pictures or videos (mp4/webm); the first one gets the large tile; face is [x, y, w, h] when a picture shows a person
props.title: heading in the words tile, 2-5 words
